**Not ready to publish.** One claim needs to come out.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "We've added a Japanese sencha to the shop" | OK. New product, product-team fact. |
| "grassy, a little sweet" | OK. Flavour description. |
| "packed with antioxidants" | **Unsupported.** This is a health claim, and the brand policy bans health claims of any kind. It's also not on the allowlist, and no source was given. |
| "best brewed cooler than you think, around 70 degrees" | OK. Brewing guidance, not a superlative claim. I'd write "70°C" so it's clear it's Celsius. |

No invented stats, testimonials, urgency, guarantees or environmental claims. The banned-word list and the structural checks are clear. No disclosure is needed, since this is our own email.

**Suggested fix**

> Subject: A new green tea
>
> Hi Tom,
>
> We've added a Japanese sencha to the shop. It's grassy and a little sweet, and it's best brewed cooler than you think, around 70°C.
>
> The Pebblebrook team

Optionally, add a link to the product page so the email has somewhere to send people. Sam needs to approve it before it goes out, as with all public content.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "packed with antioxidants", "type": "health_claim"}], "publish": false}
```
